QuestInfo.name: Homeward
QuestInfo.0: You need to talk to Mylar about the beacon.
QuestInfo.1:
Mylar says the beacon will be ready at midnight.
Can you hold out until then? You should talk with Hazelle, who's just returned.
QuestInfo.2: Hazelle said soldiers were lost. May they rest in peace...\r\n\r\nAlicia suggested that you go to the Ark, but you wisely refused.
